integrity: The given closed formulas and cubic threshold are supported by analytical renewal-integral and generator calculations. Finite consistency checks are supplementary. The originality comparison is best-knowledge and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only stationary second moments of a two-dimensional inertial active Brownian particle subject to complete Poisson resetting of position, velocity and orientation with isotropic velocity noise. It does not assert rotational symmetry of the full stationary law, parameter-free dynamics, or results for partial resetting or non-Poisson clocks.
title: A unique inertial resetting rate for isotropic centered spatial fluctuations
